beginner.headline: CNN Journalist Christiane Amanpour Leaves Network After 43 Years
beginner.brief: Christiane Amanpour is a famous journalist for CNN. She will leave the news network next year. Amanpour has worked there for 43 years. She started her job in 1983 as an assistant. Later, she became a famous correspondent reporting on wars. Now, the 68-year-old journalist wants to try new projects. A leader at CNN thanked her for her great work.

intermediate.headline: CNN Chief International Anchor Christiane Amanpour Leaves After Forty Years
intermediate.brief: Christiane Amanpour, a chief international anchor, has announced she will separate from her organisation next year after more than four decades. In a recent statement, the broadcaster explained that she made this difficult decision after many months of careful thought. She began her career there in 1983 and eventually became one of their best-known correspondents. Over the years, she has frequently reported on dangerous conflicts around the world. She has presented her own nightly interview program on international television since 2009. Amanpour expressed deep gratitude to the amazingly talented teams and field crews who shared her incredible journey. The chairman of the company described her as a highly trusted professional. She praised her teams because they battled together to seek the facts and broadcast the truth.

advanced.headline: Christiane Amanpour Exits CNN After Four Decades
advanced.brief: CNN's chief international anchor, Christiane Amanpour, has announced her impending departure from the organisation next year after more than four decades of service. Following months of contemplation and a few sleepless nights, Amanpour confirmed her intention to separate from the news channel. Amanpour commenced her tenure in 1983 on the international news desk, subsequently becoming one of the most prominent global reporters. Throughout her career, she received numerous challenging assignments, extensively covering the horrors of war across regions such as Rwanda, Afghanistan, Ukraine, and Iran. Furthermore, she has presented her own nightly interview programme on CNN International since 2009. The 68-year-old media veteran expressed that she eagerly anticipates engaging in new endeavours down the line. She also emphasised the importance of maintaining an independent approach, reminding her colleagues to always remain truthful rather than strictly neutral. CNN chairman Mark Thompson lauded her as one of the most trusted and revered media figures anywhere. Thompson acknowledged his sorrow at her exit but noted that he has come to accept this transition as the right step for her both personally and professionally. Reflecting on her legacy, Amanpour praised the camaraderie of her teams as they collectively battled to uncover facts and evidence. She asserted that their unified mission allowed them to transmit the truth to the world, operating entirely without fear nor favour.
